description: Source code for a C++ parser implementation for Python-like language constructs within the Torch JIT compiler, including parsing expressions, statements, function and class definitions, and handling type annotations.

classes.name: ParserImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the parser handling token stream and parsing logic for expressions, statements, functions, classes, and type annotations.

methods.name: mergeTypesFromTypeComment
methods.description: Merges type annotations from a type comment into a function or method declaration.

methods.name: parseExpOrExpTuple
methods.description: Parses an expression or a tuple of expressions.

methods.name: parseBaseExp
methods.description: Parses primary expressions like literals, identifiers, tuples, lists, dicts, and comprehensions.

methods.name: parseExp
methods.description: Parses an expression with operator precedence.

methods.name: parseExp(int)
methods.description: Parses an expression with a given precedence level.

methods.name: parseStatement
methods.description: Parses a single statement, including control flow, function, class, and import statements.

methods.name: parseFunction
methods.description: Parses a function definition, including optional type annotations.
